pmlb_metadata.description:
A synthetic physics model from the Feynman Lectures on Physics.         
This is the version of the model with units.
Formula and simulated variable ranges given below. 

M = n_rho*mom*tanh(mom*B/(kb*T))

n_rho in [1.0,5.0]
mom in [1.0,5.0]
B in [1.0,5.0]
kb in [1.0,5.0]
T in [1.0,5.0]

Note the original data has been down-sampled to 100,000 rows (see source).
pmlb_metadata.publication: AI Feynman - a Physics-Inspired Method for Symbolic Regression, Udrescu & Tegmark (2019), arXiv:1905.11481

target.description: M, Magnetisation, m^1 * s^(-3) * kg^1 * V^(-1)

features.name: mom
features.description: Magnetic moment, m^4 * s^(-3) * kg^1 * V^(-1)

features.name: kb
features.description: Boltzmann constant, m^2 * s^(-2) * kg^1 * T^(-1)
